messages.author: 2e733f1cd09c73fa
messages.subject: reference manual typo
parts:
I didn't see a discussion already posted for this, and I hope this is the best way to collect little quality improvements like this. 

Reference manual for v2.11.0 in section 45.3 says that the exponent of $y$ in the pdf of {/sf InvChiSquare} is $-(\nu/2 - 1)$, but I think it should be $-(\nu/2 + 1)$. (All using LaTeX notation.) Note that it is correct in section 45.4 for the {\sf ScaledInvChiSquare} distribution.

It is a small matter, but I can tell the developers care about quality and just want to help out.

Gary

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] reference manual typo
parts:
Thanks. I added an issue comment:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/2051#issuecomment-244928174

We always have a next-version manual issue on GitHub and
collect small changes there. I then just do them all before
each release. 2.12 is out soon, so these comments are
going in the next release after this one coming out soon.

- Bob
